business_summary: Omikenshi Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, processing, and sale of textile products in Japan and internationally. The company offers rayon cotton, spun yarn, and knitted fabrics; knits, wovens, and nonwoven fabrics; towels and sleeping products; and rayon steple fibre and spinning yarn. It is also involved in the wholesale of textile raw materials and textile products; leasing and sale of real estate; and procurement and sale of electronic equipment and software development. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
